paragraphs: Cayamae's Ancient Garden was born from a deep reverence for the healing power of plants and a calling to share that wisdom. Every product is made by hand in small batches, drawing on traditional plant knowledge passed down through generations and refined through years of practice.

We believe your body deserves ingredients you can pronounce — wild-harvested herbs, cold-pressed oils, and botanicals gathered with care and intention. Nothing synthetic. Nothing mass-produced. Everything made just for you.

paragraphs: Beyond her handcrafted botanical products, Cayamae offers a range of spiritual and intuitive services drawn from years of study, practice, and ancestral connection. Her gifts are deeply personal — each session is unique to the individual seeking guidance.
These are not commercial services. They are sacred exchanges between healer and seeker. Please reach out directly to discuss availability, offerings, and how she may be able to support your journey.

support.paragraph: Cayamae's work is a labor of love — gathering wild herbs, crafting remedies, sharing knowledge passed down through generations. Your support on Patreon helps sustain her practice, expand her offerings, and keep this sacred knowledge accessible to those who need it most.
